descriptionChirho: To move physically upward or travel to a higher location, especially going up to Jerusalem, a mountain, or an upper room
To go up onto a vessel such as a ship or boat, i.e., to board or embark
Of plants or seeds growing upward, sprouting and increasing in size
Of thoughts, desires, or abstract things rising up or coming into the heart or mind
To ascend to God or to heaven, used theologically of Christ's ascension to the Father
